steps: Godot headless, scratch HOME: --strategy=decent --seed=4 --skip-tutorial --market=lux --keep-running=38 (qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh, tag focus_lux).
Read the RESULT line: outcome, win_cycle, workshops_built, feed_log, skill_log.
Compare with seeds 1-3 of the same command (wins at cycles 27, 27, 29).
expected: Lux focus wins at about cycle 27-30 in the seeds where the atelier is built early (seeds 1-3: atelier at cycle 13).
actual: No win by cycle 40 (SOFT, END_OUTCOMPETED, cash 36370, lux share 0.467). Atelier built only at cycle 21; feed_log empty (no food or silk route to the station was ever logged). Cause UNKNOWN: bot feed or workshop gating; not isolated.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=1 --skip-tutorial --market=lux --keep-running=38 (same for seeds 2 and 3; all three give the same result).
Read feed_log: [23, 1, 'musk', true, 'route to station'] (seed 1; seeds 2 and 3 at cycles 22 and 26) built from planet index 1 (planet_2, Tillam).
Read storage_end['system:1'].musk and craft_totals.atelier.gems at the end of the run.
expected: Musk built up at the station (system 1) after the feed route is open, so the atelier can craft gems (2 silk + 1 musk) once LUX_4 is learned (about cycle 22).
actual: Musk in station storage is 0 at the end in seeds 1-3. No gems crafted in any run. Silk from another planet (feed_log silk route from planet index 4) does arrive (silk 500 at the station). Cause UNKNOWN: bot route set-up or route engine for a same-system source. The gem payoff of LUX_4 is therefore unmeasured.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=1 --skip-tutorial --market=lux --keep-running=38 --skip-tech=LUX_4 (seeds 2 and 3 likewise).
Compare final_cash and win_cycle with focus_lux_decent_1 (same seed, LUX_4 learned).
expected: LUX_4 (gems unlock) adds a payoff that outweighs its feed cost in the lux focus.
actual: Without LUX_4 (and LUX_6, its dependant) cash is higher by 21594, 21090 and 17060 in seeds 1-3, and win cycles are unchanged (27, 27, 29). The only felt effect is the cost of the gem feed routes (they close earning lanes). The gem payoff is not seen (see focus_lux_decent_1: musk never reaches the station).

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=3 --skip-tutorial --market=mil --keep-running=38.
Read win_cycle in the RESULT line. Seeds 1, 2 and 4 win at cycle 27.
expected: Decent-bot wins between cycles 22 and 30 (the pacing band).
actual: Win at cycle 32. Market focus variant (not the default decent run, which wins at 27 in all four seeds). Pacing flag for the mil focus.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=3 --skip-tutorial --market=bio --keep-running=38.
Read win_cycle. Seeds 2 and 4 win at 27; seed 1 wins at 30.
actual: Win at cycle 31 (seed 1 at 30). Bio focus variant only. Cash is low (mean 11.8k, seeds 8.8k to 20.3k).

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=3 --skip-tutorial --market=lux --keep-running=38 --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,LUX_1,LUX_3,LUX_5,LUX_7 (tag brb_lux); the ablation adds --skip-skill=LUX_7 (tag abl_LUX_7).
Read bot_skill_log (LUX_7 fires at cycle 26, until 33) and the win and share in both arms.
expected: LUX_7 (bot -30 pct for 8 cycles, once) changes the lux share or the win cycle.
actual: Bot skill fires as designed (seeds 1 and 3). Win cycle unchanged (28 vs 28), cash unchanged, lux share 0.774 with LUX_7 and 0.770 without. The lux share sits about 27 points above the win line, so the cut does not bite. Needs a contested run (bot strength raised) to test the node.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=1 --skip-tutorial --market=min --keep-running=38 --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,MIN_1,MIN_3,MIN_5,MIN_7 (tag brb_min), and the same with --skip-skill=MIN_7 (tag abl_MIN_7). Seeds 2-4 likewise.
Compare final_cash, win_cycle and final_shares_by_market in both arms.
expected: MIN_7 (bot -20 pct, permanent) changes the win or the cash.
actual: Share only: min share 0.02 higher with MIN_7 in all four seeds; cash identical; win cycle 27 in both arms. The min share (0.66 to 0.69) is far above the win line, so the cut is not felt in the win. Same pattern for BIO_7 (share 0.01 to 0.02, cash and win unchanged; passive node, no bot activation in any run). Contested run needed.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=1 --skip-tutorial --market=mil --keep-running=38 --skip-skill=MIL_5 (seeds 1-4).
Compare win_cycle, final_cash and final_shares_by_market with focus_mil_decent_1..4.
expected: MIL_5 (bot -50 pct on 5 of 7 cycles) changes the mil share or the win cycle.
actual: Uncontested mil share (about 0.51 to 0.59) moves by 0.003 to 0.012 with MIL_5 removed; cash changes in both directions (-4.7k, -3.2k, +8.0k, -3.6k); win cycles 27, 27, 27 (seed 3 was 32 with MIL_5, 27 without). Needs a contested run.

steps: Godot headless: --strategy=decent --seed=1 (no --skip-tutorial), --keep-running=38 (tag base_notut, seeds 1-4).
Read cash_by_cycle and ships_owned.
expected: Either the scripted bot completes the tutorial gate and plays, or the run is documented as a tutorial limit of the bot.
actual: All 4 seeds LOSS at cycle 27 with cash 2100 and 0 ships: the tutorial gate blocks ship buys and orders for the whole run, the bot never leaves cycle 1. Bot limit, not a game path (a real player completes the tutorial). UNKNOWN whether the tutorial can be completed by a scripted bot.

steps: Initial batch (skill_signoff.sh, tag abl_BIO_2, abl_MIL_2, abl_MIL_6, abl_MIN_2, abl_MIN_6): --skip-tech removed the tech count at each cycle start with Tech.counts.erase.
tech_goal_2 and tech_goal_6 fell to 6 and 8 in round 2, so one cycle's crafting can finish the tech. Check tech_log in the ablation arm.
expected: The ablated tech never finishes in any cycle.
actual: Leaking first runs: the tech finished in 4 of 4 BIO_2 seeds, 2 of 4 MIL_2, MIL_6, MIN_2 and MIN_6 seeds. Fixed in qa/bots/bot_run.gd (_ablate_techs pins the count at -1000000); the five nodes were re-run (20 runs, 0 completions). The leaking rows are not used. Tooling only; no game change.
